user.title: Golmar G2Call+
user.description: G2Call+ account and monitor label data. The local path requires the monitor to be awake (open Information in the app).

data_description.account_password: Only its SHA-256 is stored, never the plaintext password.
data_description.device_uid: Printed on the monitor label next to the password.
data_description.verify_tls: The monitor uses a self-signed certificate; leave this off unless you replaced it.
data_description.host: The IP may change if the monitor uses a randomized MAC; you can reconfigure it.

doors.title: Doors
doors.description: Doors discovered with get.device.attachInfo (known defaults are used when the monitor is asleep). The Portal stays disabled by default.

data_description.account_password: Empty = keep the current one (only its SHA-256 is stored).
data_description.device_password: The stored value is shown. Empty = keep the current one.
data_description.unlock_code: The stored value is shown. Empty = keep the current one.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate the monitor
reauth_confirm.description: The monitor rejected the device password.

reauth_confirm_cloud.title: Reauthenticate the account
reauth_confirm_cloud.description: The cloud session expired or was revoked.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the monitor. Open G2Call+ → device Information and try again.

init.title: Golmar G2Call+ options
init.description: Device {device_uid} at {host}. Unlock code: {code_status}. Device password: {device_status}. Leave sensitive fields empty to keep the current value.

data_description.unlock_code: The stored value is shown. Empty = keep the current one.
data_description.device_password: The stored value is shown. Empty = keep the current one.
